patch_description:
The current search evaluates fixed-size batches ranked mainly by Hamiltonian energy and local link pressure. This version keeps those useful signals but gives each batch separate capacity for model-guided candidates, high-uncertainty candidates, and diverse exploration. A ridge model learns from LP-scored networks using compact randomized topology and demand features; its prediction uncertainty is estimated from the regularized feature covariance and residual error.

The search starts from 26 diverse repaired samples, uses size-dependent batches of 7–9 LP trials, and maintains a 36-network archive. It mixes focused 2-switches, random switches, rotations, multi-switch kicks, and short path-relinking sequences. These choices aim to make LP calls more informative while reducing dependence on any one Hamiltonian’s energy ranking or one local neighborhood.
